description:
Foundation for the octo_pi port. No upstream behavior ported yet — just a working Elixir project ready for phase 1.

Scope:
- Resolve umbrella-vs-single-app decision (RESEARCH.md §7 Q1).
- Scaffold four apps: `octo_pi_ai`, `octo_pi_agent`, `octo_pi_coder`, `octo_pi_tui`.
- CI pipeline: `mix format --check`, `credo`, `dialyzer`, `mix test`.
- LICENSE (MIT) + `CREDITS.md` attributing `badlogic/pi-mono` (MIT) upstream.

Definition of done: `mix compile` clean, `mix check` green in CI, LICENSE + CREDITS in place.

Ref: RESEARCH.md §6 Phase 0, §7.

comments.text: Phase 0 deliverables landed: umbrella scaffold (4 apps), LICENSE + CREDITS, CI workflow, mix check alias. mix check is green locally on Elixir 1.19.5 / OTP 28.3. CI workflow not yet exercised — no git remote configured. Verify green-in-CI when the repo is pushed to GitHub.

title: Phase 0: Umbrella scaffold + CI + attribution
